reason: Current command reference and v0.21 breaking-change note require durations for --unanswered; bare hours are invalid.

en.before:
`--unanswered [hours]` keeps only questions waiting for you or for a group's admins. A question is a
message with `?` in it (a link's `?` does not count), or a reply to you or to an admin. It is
answered when you or an admin replied to it, or were the next to speak after the person who asked.
Questions younger than the hours given (24 by default) are left out: nobody has had time to answer.
When a group's admins are not known, the command says so, and only your answers count.
en.after:
`--unanswered [duration]` keeps only questions waiting for you or for a group's admins. A question is a
message with `?` in it (a link's `?` does not count), or a reply to you or to an admin. It is
answered when you or an admin replied to it, or were the next to speak after the person who asked.
Questions younger than the given duration (24 hours by default) are left out: nobody has had time to answer.
When a group's admins are not known, the command says so, and only your answers count. Use a duration such as `4h` or `1d`; a bare number of hours is not accepted.

> Aquí una «aplicación» es el registro de un programa que usa la API de Telegram. El programa es el CLI `tg`. Solo necesitas rellenar un formulario; no hace falta programar ni instalar otra aplicación. Telegram entrega `api_id` y `api_hash` para identificar el programa. El QR o código confirma después el acceso a tu cuenta. Son pasos distintos.
>
> Telegram permite un `api_id` por número. Si ya registraste una aplicación, reutiliza sus credenciales. [Explicación de Telegram](https://core.telegram.org/api/obtaining_api_id).

**Obtener credenciales manualmente en el navegador — método predeterminado:**

```sh
tg session start --app browser
```

1. El comando abre [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps). Si el navegador no se abre, entra mediante el enlace.
2. Introduce el número en formato internacional, por ejemplo `+34600111222`. El código del sitio llega por mensaje a Telegram en un dispositivo donde ya has iniciado sesión.
3. Si no hay una aplicación, rellena **API development tools**: título, nombre corto y plataforma **Desktop**. Omite este paso si ya aparece una aplicación.
4. Copia **App api_id** y **App api_hash** en la terminal cuando se soliciten. El hash no se muestra al escribirlo; es normal.
5. La terminal muestra un QR para acceder a tu cuenta. Sigue las instrucciones de escaneo de abajo.

**Rellenar el sitio automáticamente:**

```sh
tg session start --app auto
```

El comando pide el número y el código que Telegram envía para my.telegram.org, obtiene la aplicación existente o la registra y muestra el QR. Si falla, ejecuta el comando completo `tg session start --app browser` y sigue los pasos anteriores.

Las credenciales se guardan solo tras un acceso correcto a la cuenta. El código de my.telegram.org y el código de acceso a la cuenta son confirmaciones distintas: usa el mensaje correspondiente a la petición actual de la terminal.

es.before:
```sh

tg session start phone     # a phone number, the code Telegram sends, and your 2FA password
```

**QR:** escanea el código desde Telegram: Ajustes → Dispositivos → Vincular dispositivo de escritorio. El código se renueva mientras esperas.

**Teléfono:** escribe el número en formato internacional y después el código de inicio de sesión. Si la cuenta tiene una contraseña en la nube (2FA), `tg` la solicita sin mostrar lo que escribes. Con `--app auto`, solo pide el número una vez.

En ambos casos, Telegram muestra un nuevo dispositivo en la lista de sesiones de la aplicación.

7. Espera **Logged in as …**. Si el QR caduca, escanea el código actualizado de la terminal.

en.before:
`tg` keeps what it reads in a local SQLite database: the **local store**. Search, export and
`--offline` answer from it without asking Telegram. This page covers what it keeps, how to fill it,
and how to keep it current.
en.after:
The **local message archive** is a database file on your computer. It holds conversations and messages `tg` has already read or explicitly downloaded from Telegram. SQLite is the format of that database; you do not need to install or manage a database server.

Logging in does not download all chat history. A local search finds only what has been saved: an empty result does not prove the message is absent from Telegram. Fetch the required chat and time range before searching older history. `--offline` means the command uses saved data without connecting to Telegram. This page explains how to check coverage, download history and keep it current.

en.before: A session consists of your MAX account token and a stable device identity. The token is stored in the operating-system keyring; everything else lives in a file beside the configuration.
en.after:
A **session** is a saved connection to your MAX account. Its **token** is a secret authorization key: possession of it lets the CLI access that account without requesting a new login code each time. The CLI saves the token in your operating system’s protected credential store (keyring), and a separate file remembers the device so commands reuse the same connection.

Before starting, open MAX on your phone and sign in to the account you want to connect. For a first connection, use the QR instructions below; importing a token manually is an advanced alternative.

en.before:
```sh
max session start qr
```
en.after:
```sh
max session start qr
```

1. Keep the QR code visible on your computer, in the terminal or browser window opened by the command.
2. Open MAX on your phone and select the account you want to connect.
3. Go to **Settings → Devices** and open its QR login scanner. Labels can vary by app version.
4. Scan the computer’s QR code using the scanner inside MAX and confirm the connection if asked.
5. If MAX asks for an additional account password, enter it at the terminal prompt; input is hidden.
6. Wait for the command to finish successfully, then run `max account show` to verify the account and `max chats list --limit 5` to read a few chats.

**Changes something in Telegram.**

```sh
tg chats requests decline <chat> [person] [options]
```

| Аргумент | | Описание |
|---|---|---|
| `chat` | обязателен | чат: название или его часть, идентификатор, @username или `me` для «Избранного». |
| `person` | необязательный | кто запросил вступление: идентификатор из `chats requests list`. |

| Параметр | Назначение |
|---|---|
| `--all` | отклонить все ожидающие заявки; отклонения не учитываются в часовом лимите отправок. |
